answer: A jetty is single-writer for the operator that opens it: it signs one walnut per epoch, and karst locked behind it is forfeited if two walnuts share an epoch or a fork. A newcomer’s first walnut matures after 1 attested epoch; that operator’s second needs 8, third 27, k-th k^3. One jetty cannot sign in parallel, so ten clones need 1+8+...+1000=3025 closed jetty-epochs before all count.
